test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following led the official media briefing on India's Operation Sindoor in May 2025?

options.text: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri and Defence Minister Rajnath Singh
Lt Gen Rajiv Ghai and Commodore Raghu R Nair
General Anil Chauhan and Air Marshal AK Bharti
Colonel Sofiya Qureshi and Wing Commander Vyomika Singh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Colonel Sofiya Qureshi and Wing Commander Vyomika Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The official media briefing of Operation Sindoor (May 2025) was led by Colonel Sofiya Qureshi (Indian Army) and Wing Commander Vyomika Singh (Indian Air Force).
 
• The briefing highlighted jointness and coordination among India’s armed forces.
 
• It symbolised the growing leadership role of women officers in operational communication and defence outreach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lt Gen Rajiv Ghai and Commodore Raghu R Nair**

 
 
• While Lt Gen Rajiv Ghai and Commodore Raghu R Nair are senior military officials, they were not involved in leading the media briefing for Operation Sindoor.
 
• Such officials typically oversee operational and tactical aspects of military missions rather than media communications.
 
 
 
• **General Anil Chauhan and Air Marshal AK Bharti**
 
 
• General Anil Chauhan, as the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS), and Air Marshal AK Bharti, a senior officer in the Indian Air Force, are key figures in defense planning.
 
• However, their roles in Operation Sindoor were likely operational rather than focused on public or media briefings.
 
 
 
• **Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri and Defence Minister Rajnath Singh**
 
 
• They generally address diplomatic and strategic policy matters, not operational military briefings.
 
• Defence Minister leads political oversight, not tactical briefings.
